lines.text: David asks the LORD to rescue him from evil men who stir up war all day long.
The wicked sharpen their tongues like lions, and they scheme to make David stumble.
The proud hide a snare and spread a net along David's path.
David tells the LORD, "You are my God," and says the LORD hides his head in the day of battle.
David knows the LORD upholds justice for the poor, and the upright will dwell in His presence.
